title: I want to say thank you very much...
text:
I want to say thank you very much to Fran for the wonderful experience in this unforgettable place. Fran made the visit to the Alhambra and the Generalife exceptional. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the history of the place, the region, and every special corner made us enjoy the visit very much. They explained every detail in a pleasant, interesting, and very approachable way, conveying their love for this unique heritage.
In addition to their professionalism, we highlight their kindness, attention, and ability to make the experience personalized and special. Without a doubt, an essential
author: Carlos_J

title: Great Tour with Sergio
text: We had an awesome private tour with Sergio at the Alhambra. He answered all our random questions and was super knowledgeable on the history of this amazing place. I would DEFINITELY recommend him! The tour added so much depth and richness to our visit.
author: 427madisonw

title: Fantastic private tour of the Alhambra
text: We had a great tour with a very dedicated and friendly guide, Christian. He told us a lot about the background, also addressed the needs and questions of my teenage daughters, and gave us such a great 3 hours.
author: dirksR1891DW

title: Trip Highlight with Incredible Guide
text: This tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Spain! The Alahambra is spectacular, and Francisco brought it to life! His insider knowledge of just when to wait, move, fill your water bottle, skip the crowd, and the perfect photo spots were absolutely clutch. While I'm a history person, my husband isnt so much. Francisco found the perfect balance to keep us both engaged on this private tour. He was incredibly knowledgeable and could answer all our questions as well as include fun stories! The pace of the tour was perfect! We couldn't have had a better experience. Be sure to bring your pass
author: elizabethwM6929TQ

title: Great tour with lots of fun stories and history details
text: We had a wonderful three-hour tour of the Alhambra with Sergio today! He was very knowledgeable and guided us smoothly through the entire site. Along the way, he shared fascinating stories about the Alhambra and Moorish history, while also pointing out many beautiful architectural details we would have otherwise missed. The tour was informative, engaging, and full of interesting stories. Highly recommended!
author: evecN4792TK

title: Great historian perspective
text: Sergio was very knowledgeable about Alhambra and many other topics we asked him about. Despite us asking what we felt were random questions about the site, he still knew the answers. It is clear that he has a lot of historical knowledge about many topics. He made it easy to follow him and to ask questions. He allowed us time to take pictures and also took family pictures for us. He went at a manageable pace and hit the main points about the site. He made it interesting and comfortable. He also provided us with recommendations regarding seeing other sites and restaurants. We highly recommend hi
author: 781fahadj

title: Highlight of Andalusia
text:
Sergio was a joy to have as our tour leader, his knowledge and passion for the place was so evident, it made the trip so special.

Not only that but we booked on very short notice 72 hours prior and he was so accommodating both on the time and what we covered. 

Would highly recommend to anyone who wants to appreciate to the fullest extent the gift that is the Alhambra.
author: Abby_The_Adventurous

title: Sergio is the best!
text: Sergio was wonderful. Incredibly knowledgable—whenever we asked him a question, he answered without hesitation. He never rushed us. He was fun to talk to. And when a friend who was not on the tour had a mishap with her Alhambra tickets, he took it upon himself to talk with the ticket office on her behalf. Would recommend this tour to anyone.
author: kmh9871

title: Fantastic and well worth it
text: Sergio's tour was fantastic, very knowledgeable friendly and adapted to our interests. Very fair price and for me private tour of Alhambra was definitely bucket list worthy. He gave many other tips for the city and I'm writing this after an exceptional dinner and drinks at a place he recommended
author: ekaterinam279

title: Amazing tour!!
text: Amazing experience!! Sergio was extremely friendly and professional and brought the Alhambra to life with his stories and explanations.  The Alhambra itself is a spectacular experience - the tour shows off all amazing views, gardens, and architecture. Sergio was extremely knowledgable and comfortable showing everything. Excellent tour guide! Highly recommend!!
